item.title: What is Engineer persona?
item.description: What is an Engineer persona in a user research method? A user persona is a research-based, fictional but realistic representation of a user group, built from patterns found in real data, interviews, and observations. It gives your team a shared mental model of who you're building for. For Example: A persona for a platform Engineer isn’t one specific person at your company. item.title: Why Every Developer Will Eventually Design AI Systems
item.description: For most of software history, developers primarily built deterministic systems. You wrote logic. You defined rules. The machine executed them.
